outcome: Post-operative complications (vomiting, fever, wound complications, intestinal obstructions)
cohort: The study included 1231 patients who underwent a cesarean section at the study hospital between January 2016 and June 2020, with 322 patients included in each group after propensity score matching.
finding: Intraoperative blood transfusion during cesarean section was associated with increased levels of systemic inflammation indicators, higher post-operative complication rates, and a prolonged hospital stay.
followup_time: Throughout hospital stay (specifically post-operative day 1 and 3 for inflammation markers)
